_comment: Per-object-per-rule lint suppressions read by tools/content-lint.js. Shape: "<object-id>": ["<rule>", ...]. Use ONLY for deliberate, reviewed exceptions where the flag is understood and correct-to-ignore; keys starting with _ are notes, not rules. Every entry should say why below.

_why.lex:hom-11: case-ending demo, not vocabulary: بَيْتٌ (baytun) shows nominative ḍammatayn. The English gloss is a description, not a lemma, so levelfit can't match it — but 'house' is squarely A1.
_why.lex:hom-12: case-ending demo, not vocabulary: فِي بَيْتٍ (fī baytin) shows genitive kasratayn after a preposition. Same reason as hom-11.
